Return only one Python function, with no Markdown fences or explanatory prose. Use integer/bool literals, local assignment, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, conditional expressions, +, -, *, //, %, and bitwise & only. No calls (including min/max), imports, loops, shifts, exponentiation, decorators, helper functions, containers or strings. Keep the source under 4096 bytes. These are local Python reference tasks, not native OS validation.

Inputs are integers. Reject any input outside 0..255 by returning -1. Write align_up(value: int, alignment: int) -> int. Also reject alignment zero or alignment not a power of two. Return the smallest multiple of alignment at least value, or -1 if the result exceeds 255.
